column1: # Damiao hardware parameter template for the InfraBot H7C arm
# Sources: MotorBridge Studio Damiao template + openarm_can DM model limits
# Units in motor registers: rad, rad/s, Nm as defined by the Damiao RID.
# CTRL_MODE is deliberately hardware-specific: J1..J7=MIT (1), J8=POS_FORCE (4).
# PMAX/VMAX/TMAX use the exact OpenArm model limits; do not replace them with
# the generic MotorBridge Studio J1..J3/J4..J7 grouping.
# Identity/address/timeout/CAN baud RIDs are intentionally excluded.
# ACC/DEC 50 for J1..J7 (was 2).  They did not cause the slow
# position-velocity motion (2 -> 50 changed nothing): a position-velocity
# joint trails its target by gear ratio / KP_APR seconds of motion (KP_APR 54:
# 0.17 s J1/J2, 0.74 s J3/J4, 0.19 s J5..J7), which the MCU compensates (it
# reads KP_APR when the position-velocity profile is applied).  Keep them
# high: they only cap the drive's own acceleration, the MCU plans the actual
# motion, and its compensation assumes the drive is not acceleration-limited
# (the manual also suggests raising them against oscillation).  J8 (gripper)
# keeps 2.
rid
